question: Which of the following parts of a flower develops into a fruit after fertilisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ovary.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** flower** is the** reproductive part **of a plant, and it comprises several parts, including the **pistil, ovary, ovule, petal**, etc.
 
• After pollination, the** ovules** in the ovary get** fertilized **by the sperm cells, which leads to the formation of **seeds.**
 
• The ovary then develops into a** fruit **that surrounds the seeds and protects them until they are ready for** dispersal.**
 
• The fruit can be **fleshy or dry,** depending on the type of plant and its mode of reproduction.
 
• Therefore, the ovary is the part of a flower that develops into a** fruit after fertilization.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pistil **is the** female reproductive part **of a flower that consists of the **stigma, style, and ovary.**

 
 
• **​**The stigma receives the **pollen, **and the **style** connects it to the ovary.
 
 
 
• **Ovule** is the structure inside the ovary that contains the** female gamete or egg cell**.
 
 
• It gets fertilized by the **male gamete or sperm cell **to form a zygote.
 
 
 
• **Petal** is the colorful and attractive part of a flower that attracts pollinators like **bees, butterflies, **etc.
 
 
• It **does not **play a direct role in reproduction.
